arguments.title: Last-Minute Hostess Gift: Printable Cocktail Party Kit
arguments.description: A last-minute gift for the friend who always hosts: 3 printable holiday bar menus, 12 bartender-tested recipes, shopping lists and a batch calculator, delivered instantly. Pair it with a bottle from the menu.
arguments.alt_text: Last-Minute Hostess Gift: Printable Cocktail Party Kit

arguments.title: Holiday Party Prep Timeline (Bartender's Countdown)
arguments.description: A 3-day holiday party countdown: shop and print menus 3 days out, make syrups 2 days out, batch the base the day before, then citrus, ice and garnish the day of. Buy 1–2 lb of ice per guest. Full timeline in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.

arguments.title: 3 Holiday Mocktails for Your Party Menu
arguments.description: Zero-proof holiday drinks that don't feel like an afterthought: Cranberry Rosemary Fizz, Spiced Apple Cider and Sparkling Pomegranate. Serve them in the same glass with the same garnish. Recipes and printable menus in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: 3 Holiday Mocktails for Your Party Menu

arguments.title: How Many Bartenders Per Guest? Event Staffing Ratio
arguments.description: Event bar staffing: one bartender per 50 guests for a full bar, and estimate 2 drinks per guest the first hour and 1 per hour after. The Mobile Bartending Profit + Booking OS staffs and prices events automatically.
arguments.alt_text: How Many Bartenders Per Guest? Event Staffing Ratio

arguments.title: Self-Serve Holiday Bar Setup: Party Hosting Tips
arguments.description: How to host without being stuck behind the bar: batch 2 of your 3 drinks, make 1 built in the glass, set up a self-serve garnish tray and put the printed menu where the line forms. Menus and recipes in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: Self-Serve Holiday Bar Setup: Party Hosting Tips

arguments.title: Mobile Bartending Booking Rules: Deposits and Balances
arguments.description: Protect your mobile bar business: take a non-refundable retainer, collect the balance before the event and send written cancellation terms with every quote. Track inquiries, deposits and follow-ups in the Mobile Bartending Profit + Booking OS.
arguments.alt_text: Mobile Bartending Booking Rules: Deposits and Balances

arguments.title: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu: 3 Drinks + Zero-Proof
arguments.description: An easy NYE bar menu: French 75, Negroni Sbagliato, Classic Champagne Cocktail and a zero-proof Sparkling Pomegranate. One case of sparkling wine covers all four. Printable and editable menu in the Holiday Cocktail Party Menu Kit.
arguments.alt_text: New Year's Eve Cocktail Menu: 3 Drinks + Zero-Proof
